brief.retrievalTarget: Falling PVR allows a large left-to-right shunt and pulmonary overcirculation.
brief.context: When PVR falls after birth, a large VSD permits substantial left-to-right flow, pulmonary overcirculation and volume overload that may produce heart-failure signs.
brief.visualRelationship: Large VSD: falling PVR unmasks pulmonary overcirculation
brief.medium: code-native SVG with PNG raster export

factBasis.fact: VSD shunt magnitude depends on defect size and downstream resistance including PVR.
Larger defects can cause pulmonary overcirculation and heart-failure symptoms when PVR falls.

brief.wrongReadingToPrevent: Do not infer unsupported quantitative proportions or a different physiology from the abstract arrows.
